as_told.title: Bell destroyed plants and killed the first team of scientists

plain: This story is about the Bell, said to be a secret device built in Nazi Germany or occupied Czechoslovakia in the 1940s. A researcher of UFO secrecy named Richard Dolan tells it on a podcast with the host Jesse Michels. He draws on a writer named Nick Cook and his book The Hunt for Zero Point. According to Dolan, about sixty scientists worked on it, a number of them died from its effects, and the rest were executed at the end of the war so they would not talk. A second researcher, Jason Jorjani, tells it on a later episode. He speaks of a first team and says that plants placed around the device would turn to mulch, though he does not give the figure of sixty or mention the killings. If true, it would mean the Nazis built something exotic and deadly that was hidden by killing the people who knew.
